units.displayText: Nighttime, at the Oasis.

units.rawText: A figure wearing a head-mounted lamp darts between the trees in the dark forest.
units.displayText: A figure wearing a head-mounted lamp darts between the trees in the dark forest.

spans.text: A figure wearing a head-mounted lamp darts between the trees in the dark forest.

units.rawText: It's not here, and it's not there either. I can't find it no matter where I look. What on earth happened to it?
units.displayText: It's not here, and it's not there either. I can't find it no matter where I look. What on earth happened to it?

spans.text: It's not here, and it's not there either. I can't find it no matter where I look. What on earth happened to it?

units.rawText: I was right there, but then it vanished right after I turned around to grab my tool bag. Someone must have taken it...
units.displayText: I was right there, but then it vanished right after I turned around to grab my tool bag. Someone must have taken it...

units.rawText: Where could it be...
units.displayText: Where could it be...

spans.text: Where could it be...

units.rawText: Yeah, where could it have gone—eh!?
units.displayText: Yeah, where could it have gone—eh!?

units.rawText: <size=40>Uwah!</size>
units.displayText: Uwah!

units.displayText: A loud slam is heard as Fern crashes into the person rushing towards her.

spans.text: A loud slam is heard as Fern crashes into the person rushing towards her.

units.rawText: Ouch... Who was that?! What do you think you're doing, sneaking around the forest so late at night?
units.displayText: Ouch... Who was that?! What do you think you're doing, sneaking around the forest so late at night?

spans.text: Ouch... Who was that?! What do you think you're doing, sneaking around the forest so late at night?

units.displayText: I'm sorry! Are you alright? Here, let me help you up.

spans.text: I'm sorry! Are you alright? Here, let me help you up.

units.rawText: (Winces) I'm okay... I mean, an archaeologist's body isn't that weak.
units.displayText: (Winces) I'm okay... I mean, an archaeologist's body isn't that weak.

spans.text: (Winces) I'm okay... I mean, an archaeologist's body isn't that weak.

units.rawText: Huh? Is that you, Sockdolager? Right, have you seen anyone suspicious around?
units.displayText: Huh? Is that you, Sockdolager? Right, have you seen anyone suspicious around?

spans.text: Huh? Is that you, Sockdolager? Right, have you seen anyone suspicious around?

units.displayText: Anyone suspicious, you say... I think only you would fit the bill.

units.rawText: So you're saying I'm suspicious, then?! Um... Well, then again, running around at night with a headlamp IS pretty weird...

spans.text: So you're saying I'm suspicious, then?! Um... Well, then again, running around at night with a headlamp IS pretty weird...

units.rawText: Never mind that; what are you doing here?
units.displayText: Never mind that; what are you doing here?

spans.text: Never mind that; what are you doing here?

units.rawText: Well, I was originally planning to head back to the dorms around the evening...
units.displayText: Well, I was originally planning to head back to the dorms around the evening...

spans.text: Well, I was originally planning to head back to the dorms around the evening...

units.rawText: You were planning to go back by evening? That means you must be free now, right?
units.displayText: You were planning to go back by evening? That means you must be free now, right?

spans.text: You were planning to go back by evening? That means you must be free now, right?

units.rawText: Could you help me look for something? I'll make it worth your while! As a hunter, I bet your falcon's tracking skills must be really good, too!
units.displayText: Could you help me look for something? I'll make it worth your while! As a hunter, I bet your falcon's tracking skills must be really good, too!

spans.text: Could you help me look for something? I'll make it worth your while! As a hunter, I bet your falcon's tracking skills must be really good, too!

units.rawText: Wow, I can't believe Fern is actually talking about paying someone...
units.displayText: Wow, I can't believe Fern is actually talking about paying someone...

spans.text: Wow, I can't believe Fern is actually talking about paying someone...

units.rawText: Come on, just help me out already. I lost something really important! It looks like a shortsword, and it's a really precious artifact!
units.displayText: Come on, just help me out already. I lost something really important! It looks like a shortsword, and it's a really precious artifact!

spans.text: Come on, just help me out already. I lost something really important! It looks like a shortsword, and it's a really precious artifact!

units.rawText: Someone must have taken it. It vanished the moment I turned around. Dammit, once I catch the thief, I'm going to...

units.rawText: A shortsword-like... thing?
units.displayText: A shortsword-like... thing?

spans.text: A shortsword-like... thing?

units.rawText: Wait a minute, why is your face going from flushed to pale and back again? Are you okay?
units.displayText: Wait a minute, why is your face going from flushed to pale and back again? Are you okay?

spans.text: Wait a minute, why is your face going from flushed to pale and back again? Are you okay?

units.rawText: I... I'm fine, the problem is with my falcon, Hobbie. It might be that... <size=28>thief</size> you were talking about.
units.displayText: I... I'm fine, the problem is with my falcon, Hobbie. It might be that... thief you were talking about.

units.rawText: What? But how?
units.displayText: What? But how?

spans.text: What? But how?

units.rawText: It's true, I saw it from far away just before the sun had fully gone down, holding something that looked like a sword in its beak. It looked pretty weird, too.
units.displayText: It's true, I saw it from far away just before the sun had fully gone down, holding something that looked like a sword in its beak. It looked pretty weird, too.

spans.text: It's true, I saw it from far away just before the sun had fully gone down, holding something that looked like a sword in its beak. It looked pretty weird, too.

units.rawText: I told it to come back, but it wouldn't listen, then it just flew away in a flash of bluish light, so I've been looking for it ever since...
units.displayText: I told it to come back, but it wouldn't listen, then it just flew away in a flash of bluish light, so I've been looking for it ever since...

units.rawText: Huh? Isn't that a coincidence! So you're saying...

spans.text: Huh? Isn't that a coincidence! So you're saying...

units.rawText: Yeah, if I'm not wrong... the artifact you lost was probably taken by Hobbie...

spans.text: Yeah, if I'm not wrong... the artifact you lost was probably taken by Hobbie...

units.rawText: Why is this happening—I can't believe it. I won't be able to make tonight's sale...

units.rawText: I'm so sorry! I don't know what got into it. If there's anything I can do to make up for it, I will. I'll help you get stuff at the next sale, too!

units.rawText: Hmm... That'd be good. Still, we need to take care of the business at hand. After all, that sword has some weird effects...
units.displayText: Hmm... That'd be good. Still, we need to take care of the business at hand. After all, that sword has some weird effects...

spans.text: Hmm... That'd be good. Still, we need to take care of the business at hand. After all, that sword has some weird effects...

units.displayText: What kind of weird effects?

spans.text: What kind of weird effects?

units.rawText: Well, that's kind of a long story... In any case, you should stay away from it.
units.displayText: Well, that's kind of a long story... In any case, you should stay away from it.

units.rawText: Alright, let's go, then!
units.displayText: Alright, let's go, then!

units.rawText: If the security system didn't go off, then it should be fine. Maybe some of the Dolls are just messing around.

spans.text: If the security system didn't go off, then it should be fine. Maybe some of the Dolls are just messing around.

units.rawText: Don't worry. If there really was a problem, I'd be the first on the scene to help.

units.rawText: You're right, you're so reliable, Cascadia! Thank you for helping us out during that big incident earlier!

units.rawText: Ack—So bright! So gold! What IS this? Wow, this design is lovely. It's like a sparkling tree.

units.displayText: How is it? It's pretty, right?

units.rawText: As Chanzhi watches Cascadia leave, she sighs quietly and looks down at the intricately stitched protective suit. The beautiful tree motif looks like it came straight out of a myth.
